messages:
Rhea: FYI saw a spike in unclaimed leads right after yesterday's webinar promo blast. ~9% unclaimed at 10m, mostly demo-requests and APAC. tagging @Tom @Nina. report: https://app.hubspot.com/contacts/1234567/filter/unclaimed-webinar
Tom: thanks. are those RR flows or direct-assign? we had a small SF mapping change rolled last week.
Nina: grabbed samples. ~75% RR, 25% direct-assign. interestingly SF Connector Bot shows duplicate owner events where owner is created in SF ~18s after HS claim ack -> leads end up unassigned in SF. looks like our ack_window is 12s which is too aggressive combined with webhook backpressure.
SF Connector Bot: event: owner_provision_delay average 18s (sample window 2024-08-01T12:00Z - 12:30Z). ref: sf-sync/logs/2024-08-01
Carlos: business impact: webinar follow-up needs same-day outreach. missed claims = missed demos. Can we introduce a debounce on SF owner churn and a dead-letter owner fallback?
Rhea: short-term mitigation proposal:
- increase ack_window to 45s for marketing connectors (canary 15% traffic)
- enable prewarm_enrichment=true for webinar leads (we can tag inbound via campaign param)
- add SF owner debounce: wait 40s before clearing owner if HS reports unassigned
- add DL owner = "marketing-fallback" after 8m unclaimed and notify #sales
- add a circuit-breaker for enrichment vendor: if 5xx/429 > threshold -> route to lightweight enrichment local cache
Tom: agree. i'll open a tiny router PR and add a canary flag. will also add a metric: pct_unclaimed_10m_by_campaign.
Nina: i'll update SF mapping and add the 40s debounce to connector. also will add a check to avoid double-assign churns.
Carlos: sales ask: please add Slack notify for any demo-request unclaimed at 4m and a second escalation at 10m with lead metadata.
Rhea: owners: Tom (PR + canary + metric), Nina (SF debounce + mapping), Carlos (sales notify playbook + escalation text), Rhea (monitor and rollback criteria). I'll schedule a 20m sync once canary hits 15%.
Tom: PR link: https://github.com/redwood-inference/leadrouter/pull/534 
Canary start ts 1737654328 for 15% marketing traffic. rolling now. :rocket:
HubSpot Bot: webhook retries spike 2024-08-01T12:02:10 - 12:08:30 (44 retries). ref: hs-webhooks/2024-08-01
Nina: quick diagnostic to run (BQ):
```
SELECT lead_id, created_at, campaign, enrichment_ms, rr_ack_window_s, sf_owner_provision_delay_s
FROM `prod.marketing.inbound_leads`
WHERE created_at >= TIMESTAMP_SUB(CURRENT_TIMESTAMP(), INTERVAL 1 DAY)
AND campaign LIKE '%webinar%'
AND claimed_at IS NULL
ORDER BY created_at DESC
LIMIT 200;
```
This should show campaign skew and provisioning delay.
Rhea: rollback criteria: if pct_unclaimed_10m increases or SF owner errors increase > baseline. Thanks team 44d
